title: Tenancy Share of the Returned-Payment Fee, Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
The returned-payment fee on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement carries a tenancy share, counted in whole calendar months from the agreement's move-in date to the handling date, whatever unit the agreement has since been moved to:

| Whole calendar months since the agreement's move-in date | Share of the fee the tenant pays |
|---|---|
| 48 or more | 80 percent |
| 24 to 47 | 90 percent |
| under 24 | the full fee |

The share multiplies the fee as limited by the size of the returned payment, and the product is rounded to the cent, half up, once. A transfer to another unit does not restart the count: it runs from the move-in date of the agreement itself.

## Edges (hypothetical move-in 15 March 2023)

| Handling date | Whole months | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 14 March 2025 | 23 | full fee |
| 15 March 2025 | 24 | 90 percent |
| 14 March 2027 | 47 | 90 percent |
| 15 March 2027 | 48 | 80 percent |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)
A limited fee of $35.00 on an agreement in force 50 months: 80 percent of $35.00 is $28.00.
